subject: MAP template and initial MAP doc for Caldera evaluation
messages:
From: Alexandra Price <alexandra.price@calderahealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP template and kickoff ask

Hey Markus —

Thanks for the demo last week. The team asked me to kick off a short MAP so we can align milestones and tech validation before committing to a pilot. Could you share your MAP template and a slide skeleton we can quickly plug into our roadmap?

Wed like to:
- See a concise week0 checklist for infra access and data samples
- Technical validation gates (latency/cost/QA thresholds)
- Recommended acceptance criteria for pilot success

Target internal deadline for alignment is the end of May — hoping to get a first draft this week.

Im also looping procurement (Samir) shortly; for now this is purely scoping.

Appreciate it —
Alexandra Price
Head of ML Engineering | Caldera Health
alexandra.price@calderahealth.com

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Price <alexandra.price@calderahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP template and kickoff ask

Hi Alexandra —

Great to hear — and absolutely. Ive attached our MAP template (doc) and a lightweight slide sketch that teams commonly use to brief execs. I also seeded a first-pass doc with the high-level milestones we discussed during the demo. Links are below.

Quick notes and asks so we can tailor the draft:
- Stakeholders: who will own acceptance from Product / Security / Procurement? (names/email)
- Target pilot length and target close date (you mentioned July as a possibility)
- Top 3 technical risks we should surface in the MAP

Attachments: MAP_Template_V1.gdoc, MAP_Slides_Sketch.pptx
Draft links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDef-MAP_TEMPLATE_V1
             https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1xYzSlides_Sketch

Ill ask Marissa to drop technical milestones into the doc (week0 ops + validation gates). Ben will help with pricing/contract cadence.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ill share the seeded doc now.
2) Alexandra, if you can add stakeholders and any procurement timing, well iterate and post a 30-minute MAP review call.

Available times this week for a 30-min review: Thu 5/22 10–12 PT, Fri 5/23 1–3 PT. Which works best?

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Lead Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP template and kickoff ask

Alexandra / Markus —

Ive seeded the doc with the week0 ops checklist and three technical validation gates:
- Data ingest & schema sanity (samples + small batch run)
- Inference latency P50/P95 targets on your baseline prompt set
- Output quality regression (sample prompts + eval rubric)

I also added a short owner matrix and suggested timelines for a 6-week pilot that culminates in a go/no-go. See the "Tech Milestones" section in the linked doc.

Small attachments: week0-checklist.xlsx (ops owners, access steps).

If youd like, I can convert the tech milestones into a short playbook slide for your ML leadership.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

- Stakeholders: Priya Rao (Product, priya.rao@calderahealth.com), Daniel Wu (Security, daniel.wu@calderahealth.com), Samir Joshi (Procurement, samir.joshi@calderahealth.com). Ive looped Samir earlier today so hes aware the procurement ask is coming.
- Target: Were aiming for an internal pilot decision by 2025-07-15. A 6-week pilot timeline looks fine.

Samir will reach out on contract timing — for scoping, anticipated ARR for pilot (license + infra) is ~ $75k.

We can do the MAP review call Thu 5/22 10:30 PT — that works for me.

Alexandra
